raw_html: [[Finesse]] +13[[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Finesse]] +13:''' This weapon has a Small air elemental bound to it. The wielder can use a finesse weapon as if he had the [[Weapon Finesse]] feat. In addition, the weapon grants a +13 enhancement bonus to the wielder's [[Dexterity]] score.
